indexes.name: example_tree_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX example_tree_pkey ON public.example_tree USING btree (id)

indexes.name: example_tree_title_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX example_tree_title_idx ON public.example_tree USING btree (title)

triggers.name: trg_example_tree_touch
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_example_tree_touch BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.example_tree FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.touch_example_tree()

objects.view_definition: SELECT id, title FROM public.example_tree WHERE title IS NOT NULL
